result.limits: Coverage uses real contract prices, no MES-to-NES scaling. Missing bars may reflect inactivity or vendor omissions; do not forward fill. Aggregate volume is not available bid/ask depth or a guaranteed fill. Contract/account margin, all-in fees and live receipt latency remain unverified. No nano account return is reported.

h3_integrity_and_accounting_audit.scope: Integrity and accounting, event-date eligibility and timing; not actual executable fills, source truth or forward profitability.

nano_roll_followup.limitations: A reduction in missing slots would indicate that the earlier fixed-December-contract result cannot stand in for customary nearby-contract coverage. It would not prove spreads, executable depth, fill probability or broker eligibility.

additional_verification.m2_parity_scope: Metrics, every trade, equity curve and daily records; regression replays, not new parameter trials.
additional_verification.roll_boundary_checks: Sep 11 selects U6, Sep 14 selects Z6 for NES and MES; Oct 1 rejected.
additional_verification.shared_missing_window: Both selected U6 contracts lack 24 five-minute bars on 2026-09-11 13:00 through 14:55 America/New_York. Cause unresolved; do not attribute missing aggregates to illiquidity alone.
